The '''Invasion Zone''' was a surface level area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]<ref name="LotS" /> which came under [[Invasion of Manaan|attack]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]<ref name="Dead">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Dead in the Water|[[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]}}</ref> in [[3625 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Invasion Zone appears in the [[BioWare]] developed MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' as a daily area.
